effective.basis: TCG release of the first printing carrying the new text (SGX2-END09, Speed Duel GX: Midterm Paradox)

transitions.historical_text: You can only activate this card's effect during your opponent's damage calculation. Make the ATK of a monster attacking this card 0 during damage calculation. This effect can only be used once as long as this card remains face-up on the field.
transitions.modern_text: Once while face-up on the field, during damage calculation in your opponent's turn, if this card is being attacked (Quick Effect): You can target the attacking monster; make that target's ATK 0 during damage calculation only.
transitions.summary: Wording modernisation only: the goat variant's script is behaviourally identical to the modern one - the entire diff is Duel.IsTurnPlayer(1-tp) rewritten as Duel.GetTurnPlayer()~=tp (the same predicate for a two-player duel) and RESET_PHASE|PHASE_DAMAGE_CAL rewritten with '+' over disjoint bits. Every English revision from v1 through v5 preserves the same resolution: a once-while-face-up EFFECT_TYPE_QUICK_O on EVENT_PRE_DAMAGE_CALCULATE, restricted to the opponent's turn with this card as the attack target, setting the attacker's ATK to 0 for that damage calculation only. The modern text's explicit 'target' is not a targeting change - Duel.SetTargetCard(Duel.GetAttacker()) is present in both scripts and no EFFECT_FLAG_CARD_TARGET difference appears in the diff.

review.notes: Upstream ships the goat variant for period display text; behaviour is identical, so this is a cosmetic record and the upstream reference is kept as baseline in the exemplar-C sense. Baseline goat/c504700174.lua matches lineage v1 (DB1-EN159, Dark Beginning 1, 2004-10-12) exactly; v0 (MRD-027, 2002-06-26) predates it and is not recorded. Intermediate versions v2 (RP01-EN032), v3 (MRD-027 via Legendary Collection, 2010-10-01) and v4 (LCJW-EN226, 2013-10-11) are all the same effect reworded. The packet lists a second upstream code, 511002507 'Suijin (Anime)' in unofficial/, which is a different card entirely (a hand-to-S/T-Zone placement, an attack negation, and a Sanga/Kazejin ATK-averaging effect; 0.3741 text ratio) and is excluded from this record. Data oddity noted but not load-bearing: lineage v2's set_dates for Retro Pack carry tcg-na 2024-08-23 alongside tcg-eu 2008-07-08; no change here is dated from v2, and the recorded cosmetic change is anchored to v5 (SGX2-END09, 2022-10-06).
